terra.problem: “Their lives were tied up with his” is another idiom that may be unclear to a 10-year-old. Say instead that they depended on the king for protection and hope. Also, specify that Zedekiah was the last king of Judah and explain who the Chaldeans were.

The notes differ about Josiah: Jamieson-Fausset-Brown suggests the words may originally have referred to him, while Gill rejects Josiah as the king meant here. Jamieson-Fausset-Brown also applies the words to Zedekiah here.
